_doc: Source of truth for skill -> hook pairing in the SKELETON. plugins/kipi-core/scripts/skill-hook-audit.py enforces it (invoked by validate-separation.py, so by kipi check): every skill on disk is triaged, every 'wired' claim names a hook that EXISTS and is REFERENCED in a tracked wired config (this is the orphan catch), and debt may only SHRINK. Created 2026-08-21 for ASK-965 finding-13. Each status below was verified by reading .claude/settings.json and every plugins/*/hooks/hooks.json, not by trusting the prose in .claude/rules/skill-hook-pairing.md -- that prose is exactly the class of unverified claim ASK-965 exists to stop.

status_meaning.wired: deterministic rules gated by a hook that exists AND is referenced in a tracked wired config
status_meaning.debt: has deterministic rules but no firing hook yet (a ratcheted shortfall, may only shrink)
status_meaning.in-script: deterministic validation runs inside the skill's own code / a shared choke point, no separate hook
status_meaning.interpretive: judgment-based or runtime-behavioral rules, not file-content-on-a-path; no content hook applies

fable-discipline.note: prd-os plugin hooks.json; blocks a test touching a live data path

deck-ai.note: validation lives in the renderer, not a content hook

architecture-review.note: its own SKILL.md says so: a judgment skill, no paired hook, same posture as research-mode

research-mode.note: runtime tool-call caps + attribution judgment, not file content; token-guard caps calls

learn-from-correction.note: core rule 'never auto-edit the target' is behavioral, not a file-content check

council.note: debate logic is judgment; the decisions.md origin-tag rule is gated separately by decision-origin-tag-lint

brand.note: no deterministic rules; voice lives in founder-voice

design.note: token validators are optional CLI tools; per the skill-hook-pairing decision rule

ui-ux-pro-max.note: code-skill carve-out, checked by its own build

improve.note: the deterministic half is improve_ground.py, which the skill must run (exit 2 = skip); the critique half is judgment. No content-on-a-path rule, so no PostToolUse hook applies (prd-morning-brief-learns issue 13, kipi-core 1.9.3)
